measures.id: One Percent Transportation Special Purpose Local Option Sales and Use Tax (TSPLOST)
measures.title: Douglas County one percent TSPLOST
measures.summary: Would impose a special one percent sales and use tax in the special district of Douglas County for up to six years to raise no more than an estimated $160,000,000 for transportation purposes. Approval would also authorize Douglas County to issue up to $80,000,000 in general obligation debt for those purposes.
measures.yesMeans: A one percent transportation sales tax would be imposed for up to six years and the county could issue up to $80 million in bonds for transportation.
measures.noMeans: The transportation sales tax would not be imposed and the bonds would not be authorized.
